items.headline: Kevin Yu leads Austin
items.text: Kevin Yu holds the early lead at Austin Championship at 5-under through 10 holes, with Erik van Rooyen, Chandler Phillips, Brice Garnett, and Blades Brown close at 4-under.

items.headline: Rory McIlroy penalty insight
items.text: A rules official explains Rory McIlroy could have avoided his recent two-stroke penalty with a different action, clarifying the rules impact in his event.
